question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a red ball, Bob has a orange ball, Claire has a green ball, Dave has a white ball, Eve has a grey ball, Fred has a black ball, and Gertrude has a yellow ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Alice and Gertrude swap balls. Then, Bob and Dave swap balls. Then, Fred and Claire swap balls. Then, Eve and Alice swap balls. Then, Eve and Claire swap balls. Then, Bob and Gertrude swap balls. Finally, Alice and Fred swap balls. At the end of the game, Dave has the
Options:
(A) red ball
(B) orange ball
(C) green ball
(D) white ball
(E) grey ball
(F) black ball
(G) yellow ball
solution:
Ball colors in order (Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude):
Initial: (red, orange, green, white, grey, black, yellow)
1. Alice ↔ Gertrude: (yellow, orange, green, white, grey, black, red)
2. Bob ↔ Dave: (yellow, white, green, orange, grey, black, red)
3. Fred ↔ Claire: (yellow, white, black, orange, grey, green, red)
4. Eve ↔ Alice: (grey, white, black, orange, yellow, green, red)
5. Eve ↔ Claire: (grey, white, yellow, orange, black, green, red)
6. Bob ↔ Gertrude: (grey, red, yellow, orange, black, green, white)
7. Alice ↔ Fred: (green, red, yellow, orange, black, grey, white)
Dave has the orange ball, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
